guides.name: Repair a gas water heater (burner, gas valve, pilot)
stopIf: If you smell gas, leave the house now and call 911 or your gas company from outside.
If a carbon monoxide alarm sounds, get everyone outside and call 911.
Until it is fixed, leave the gas control on its pilot or off setting.

sources.title: Plumbing Work - Express Permit Program terms - City of Chicago
sources.quote: Carbon monoxide detector For a fuel-fired water heater installed within a residential unit, the installer must verify that a functioning carbon monoxide detector is present within the residential unit.

sources.title: Carbon Monoxide's Impact on Indoor Air Quality | US EPA
sources.quote: Sources of CO include: unvented kerosene and gas space heaters leaking chimneys and furnaces back-drafting from furnaces, gas water heaters, wood stoves and fireplaces gas stoves

sources.title: Maintenance Checklist | ENERGY STAR
sources.quote: Improperly operating gas (or oil) connections are a fire hazard and can contribute to health problems.

guides.name: Replace or install a gas water heater
stopIf: If you smell gas, leave the house now and call 911 or your gas company from outside.
If a carbon monoxide alarm sounds, get everyone outside and call 911.
If the tank is leaking, close the cold-water valve on top and call a plumber.
